梅依管是一種雙簧氣鳴樂器，用於土耳其民間音樂。其主體呈圓柱形，以木製成，正面有七: The mey is a double-reed aerophone used in Turkish folk music. Its body is cylindrical and made of wood, with seven fingerholes on the front and one on the back, and a range of about an octave; it also comes in three sizes, the pitch falling from the smallest to the largest. It sounds through a reed, at the end of which sits a tuning clip that can be moved up and down to tune the instrument and steady the pitch. It is close to the duduk and the balaban, but its history and geography differ.
梅依管是土耳其民間音樂的雙簧氣鳴樂器，與 duduk、balaban 幾乎相同，: The mey is a double-reed aerophone of Turkish folk music and is almost the same as the duduk and the balaban; the difference lies in history and geography. Similar instruments exist in many parts of Eurasia, including the European aulos and douçaine, the balaban of Azerbaijan and Iran, the Uyghur balaman, the Georgian duduki, the Armenian duduk, the Japanese hichiriki, the Korean piri, the Chinese guanzi and houguan, and the Cambodian pey au. Farmer (1936) and Picken (1975) hold that the mait, monaulos and auloi have major similarities with the mey; Hellenistic Egypt had the mait or monaulos, Anatolia had the auloi, and they appear on pottery.
梅依管為氣鳴樂器，琴身呈圓柱形，以木材製成，常用李木、胡桃木、櫸木等較硬木材。發: The mey is an aerophone with a cylindrical body made of wood, usually a harder wood such as plum, walnut or beech. It sounds by means of a double reed whose material the source does not state. The body also carries a tuning clip, used to adjust the pitch and steady the tuning, whose material is not stated; the protective cap that covers the mouth of the reed when the instrument is not being played is of wood. The materials of the remaining parts are not stated.
梅依管的共鳴方式特殊，音波在管身內產生多層次的共鳴，使其聲音既有木管樂器的溫潤感: The mey resonates in a distinctive way: sound waves build up resonance in several layers inside the body, so that its tone has both the warmth of a woodwind and the carrying power of brass. Compared with the oboe the mey is softer; compared with the flute it sounds fuller and warmer. This distinctive acoustic character gives it a striking expressiveness in folk music, especially in long, sinuous melodies, where its tone is full of poetry and feeling.
梅依管的基本操作順序為：先依尺寸選擇主體與簧片，將簧片裝於主體，再以調音夾沿簧片: The basic order of operations on the mey is this: choose the body and the reed by size, fit the reed to the body, then move the tuning clip up and down along the end of the reed to settle the pitch and fix its position so that the pitch does not change; when the instrument is not in use, cover the mouth of the reed with the wooden protective cap. It sounds by the vibration of the double reed, whose mouth is a large, almost flat cylinder while the part joining the body is a conical round, which produces the deep tone. The points for a beginner are the layout of seven fingerholes in front and one behind, and keeping the reed and tuning clip steady so that the range of about an octave stays clear.
梅依管音色獨特而具有穿透力，具備明亮卻不刺耳的特質。其音色溫潤而富有表現力，帶有: The mey has a distinctive, carrying timbre, bright without being harsh. Its tone is warm and expressive, with a slight nasal resonance that gives the whole sound a warm human feeling. Its range is wide, covering everything from a deep, full low register to a clear, ringing high one.
